inputs.objective: Implement list_accounts(session, term, limit, offset=0) for SQLAlchemy 2.0.36; keep Base, Account and Entry models and schema. For nonempty term, select accounts having at least one Entry.title containing that literal case-sensitive text, escaping SQL LIKE wildcard/escape characters. Empty term selects all accounts including those without entries. Order accounts by ID, apply offset/limit to distinct accounts, and include ALL entries for each returned account ordered by entry ID. Return plain dicts {'id': id, 'name': name, 'entries':[{'id':id,'title':title}, ...]}. For a positive limit use exactly one SELECT, with no lazy or per-account queries. limit/offset must be nonnegative ints excluding bool; invalid values raise ValueError before querying. A zero limit returns [] without a query. The caller owns the Session; do not commit or close it. Keep dependencies pinned.
